headline: Tornadoes SLAY 6 Incl. Boy 12 😱🌪️💥 MI/OK Carnage
text:
TWISTER GANG 🌪️😈💨 DROPPED the HAMMER 🔨💥 on Michigan 🏭🍆 and Oklahoma 🤠🐎, YEETING 6 SOULS ☠️🙏 to the RAINBOW BRIDGE 🌈🍀 – incl. THICC lil' homie Silas Anderson 🧒💔, 12yo Michigan MVP who peaced out surrounded by fam 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦😢 in Edwardsburg! Four BODIED in southern MI 🍑🌪️, two ZAPPED in OK 👻⚡ near Beggs, with DOZENS HURT 😩🚑 and rescue squads STILL DIGGIN' thru the WRECKAGE 🏚️🔍 like post-rave cleanup 🍾💦!

Storms went FULL BEAST MODE 🐺🌪️, UPROOTING TREES 🌳🪓, SNAPPIN' POWER LINES ⚡💥, SMASHIN' BUILDINGS 🏢🔨, and RIPPIN' ROOFS OFF HOUSES 🏠🍑 FLYIN' like Dorothy's crib in Oz 🧹🛸! NWS 📡⚠️ yellin' MORE THUNDERBANGERS ⛈️🔥 and FLASH FLOODS 🌊🚫 from Great Plains 🐴🌾 to Texas 🤠🌵 thru the weekend – STAY WOKE, peeps! 😰👀

Branch County MI SHERIFF 🛡️🚔 SPILLIN' TEA ☕: THREE KIA near Union City 🌪️📍, 12 INJURED 😵‍💫, power OUTAGES 🖤🚫 and ROAD BLOCKS 🚧 expected – VIDEOS droppin' MASSIVE WHIRLWIND PORN 🌪️🍆💨 with DEBRIS BOMBS 💣🪨 flyin' thru Three Rivers parking lots 🅿️🌀! Local mama bear 🐻‍❄️👩 tellin' BBC/CBS: 'Saw that funnel CUMMIN' STRAIGHT AT MY BABY GIRL 👶💨, fam crib, but God had the ULTIMATE SHIELD 🛡️✨ – GRATEFUL AF 🙌!'

Cass County 🚨: ONE DEAD 💀, HOMES & POLE BARNS 🏘️🚜 TOTALED 🤯🗑️, HUNDREDS BLACKED OUT 🖤😤! Gov Gretchen Whitmer 💪👩‍💼 activated EMERGENCY MODE 🚨🔥 for Branch/Cass/St Joseph counties: 'Heart BROKEN 💔 for fams who lost legends 🕊️ and hurt Michiganders – teams ON IT like Elon on Mars 🚀🛸!'

OK side? Emergency boss Jeff Moore 🦸‍♂️🏃‍♂️💨 racin' to clear 4-MILE DAMAGE PATH 🛣️💥 in Okmulgee (30mi south of Tulsa 🎸🤠), TWO DROPPED in Beggs 😢⚰️! Gov Kevin Stitt 🐎👨‍💼 declared STATE OF EMERGENCY 📜🚨 for Alfalfa/Creek/Grant/Major/Okmulgee/Rogers/Tulsa/Wagoner – 'Oklahomans GETTIN' ALL THE BACKUP 🛡️💰 post-storm SLAP!'

Mother Nature THROWIN' HISSY FITS 🌪️😡 across US 🇺🇸🗺️, but first responders SLAYIN' recovery like Avengers assemble 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♀️🔥 – prayers UP for the fallen angels 👼💔 and survivors HOLDIN' STRONG 💪🙏! No cap, stay safe out there, fam – tornadoes don't play fair ⚔️🌪️!
